daily.today_energy: The scales are tilting toward clarity today, Libra. Your intuition is sharp and your vibes are magnetic. This is a day to trust what your gut's telling you—that whisper in the back of your mind? Pay attention.
daily.love: Connection feels less complicated right now. Whether you're coupled or single, there's an ease in how you're showing up for others. Real talk usually flows better when you're not overthinking it. Let authenticity lead.
daily.career: Your ideas have wings today. That project or conversation you've been hesitant about? The energy supports you speaking up. Your perspective brings balance to any room—lean into that natural gift of seeing all sides.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentle movement and real rest. Nothing extreme needed. A walk, some stretching, or just sitting quietly will reset your nervous system. Honor what feels nourishing rather than forcing it.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to get real with yourself, Libra. Mercury's moving through your sector of reflection, so expect clarity to hit different. Trust the quiet moments—they're where your actual magic lives rn.
weekly.love: Venus is doing her thing, making you feel everything more intensely. Whether you're coupled up or solo, this is your sign to stop overthinking the vibes and just *feel* them. Vulnerability looks good on you this week, honestly.
weekly.career: Your energy's giving quiet confidence, and people are noticing. This isn't the week to make big moves—it's about building momentum behind the scenes. The groundwork you're laying now hits different later, trust the process.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more rest than usual, and that's not weakness, that's wisdom. Lean into gentler movement, better sleep, maybe some reflection practices. Your nervous system wants to reset, so let it.
